text: 中国财政部发行2年期债券，规模1300亿元，发行利率1.2300%，边际利率1.2500%，预期1.2500%，投标倍数2.61倍，边际倍数5.57倍； 中国财政部发行7年期债券，规模1000亿元，发行利率1.4900%，边际利率1.5100%，预期1.5000%，投标倍数4.13倍，边际倍数3.03倍。
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issued 2-year bonds, with a scale of 130 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 1.2300%, a marginal rate of 1.2500%, an expected rate of 1.2500%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.61 times, and a marginal ratio of 5.57 times; China's Ministry of Finance issued 7-year bonds, with a scale of 100 billion yuan, an issuance rate of 1.4900%, a marginal rate of 1.5100%, an expected rate of 1.5000%, a bid-to-cover ratio of 4.13 times, and a marginal ratio of 3.03 times.
